GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-10-01T12:31:12Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Non standart aggregation with GROUP BY
Description: ** SQL **
```
SELECT MAX(1)  FROM (SELECT 1) one WHERE 1 = 0 GROUP BY NULL;
```
Current result:

```
┌─max(1)─┐
│      0 
└──────┘
```

Expected SQL Standart behavior (MySQL, sqlite, etc):

```
mysql> SELECT MAX(1)  FROM (SELECT 1) one WHERE 1 = 0 GROUP BY NULL;
Empty set (0,00 sec)
```

But with a little changed SQL all ok

```
SELECT MAX(1)  FROM (SELECT 1) one WHERE 1 = 0;
```

Clickhouse
```
┌─max(1)─┐
│      0
└──────┘
```
Mysql
```
mysql> SELECT MAX(1)  FROM (SELECT 1) one WHERE 1 = 0;
+--------+
| MAX(1) |
+--------+
|   NULL |
+--------+
1 row in set (0,00 sec)
```
